title_en: Good News (4/20): The World's Longest Footbridge
note_en: 一旦…就… means "once…, (then)…" and sets a trigger for what follows: 一旦风速达到每小时约一百三十五公里，大桥就会暂时关闭 "once the wind reaches about 135 kilometers per hour, the bridge closes temporarily." English puts the trigger word only in the first clause, but Chinese also needs 就 before the verb of the second clause; 一旦 also hints that the situation is unwelcome or not expected to happen often.
